access_links.label: 2015 Street Tree Census - Tree Data (NYC Open Data)

description: Street tree data from TreesCount! 2015, New York City's third decadal street tree census and the largest citizen science effort in NYC Parks' history, carried out by volunteers and staff from May 2015 to October 2016. The census found 666,134 trees along the city's streets, and the published table has 683,788 rows. Each record gives tree species, trunk diameter and perceived health, with companion blockface data showing collection status. The census became the basis of the Forestry Management System (ForMS), NYC Parks' operational tree inventory, which is published as separate datasets. Coverage: street trees under NYC Parks jurisdiction in all five boroughs. Access: free download and API. Licence: NYC Open Data terms. Caveats: a snapshot in time, not updated since 2017; ForMS holds current records. Simulation uses: street canopy inventories for heat, stormwater and windthrow risk, including trees falling on lines and roads in storms. Related records: London public realm trees and Treepedia.
